Researchers have set a new record for quantum error correction, achieving unprecedented levels of qubit fidelity and reduced logical‑gate errors. This breakthrough narrows the gap between current noisy intermediate‑scale quantum devices and fully fault‑tolerant, scalable quantum computers, marking a significant step toward practical, reliable quantum computation.
